sub_site: mesothelioma tumour tissue (TCGA-MESO, PanCancer Atlas via cBioPortal)

data_source.dataset: TCGA-MESO PanCancer Atlas microbiome signatures in cBioPortal (Poore-type data)

evidence.quote: TCGA data on 86 MMe patients from cBioPortal underwent bespoke analysis
The “Mesothelioma (TCGA, PanCancer Atlas)” study was selected because it included the highest number of patients together with the pertinent intratumor microbiome signatures
pertinent intratumor microbiome signatures and survival data required for the study

decontamination.tool: cross-check against contaminant information in the source article's supplement

evidence.quote: This was performed through cross-examination with supplementary information from the aforementioned original article which added the signatures to cBioPortal.
After decontamination analysis, this number was reduced to 107

notes: Mesothelioma treated as internal non-mucosal tumour (eligibility judgement). 107 survival-associated genera after decontamination; main text names only the 27 with cancer literature hits (viruses excluded) - full list in Supplementary Table 1 (not used per <3 rule). Decontamination = removal of genera flagged in the source article (Poore et al.) supplement; coded literature_list (could be tool/Poore-style).
